summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Gorgeous Fashion Boutique. 22/22 pytest backend tests pass (health, 3-admin login, JWT auth guards, contact, bookings CRUD+status PATCH, reviews, media auth gating, cloudinary signature, settings CRUD). Frontend landing/gallery/contact/book/admin flows all work end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~450 lines) is acceptable but approaching the threshold — consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/media.py, routers/bookings.py if it grows further.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests. Fine for public API usage here, but tighten to explicit origins before production.
login endpoint calls req.email.lower() but seed stores email verbatim from .env. Works today because env emails are already lowercase — document this invariant or normalise on seed.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Add slowapi or similar before production.
PATCH /api/bookings/{id} takes status as a query param — acceptable but a request body would be more RESTful and enum-validated.
test_credentials: admin1@gorgeousfashion.com / Gorgeous2025A (also admin2/Gorgeous2025B, admin3/Gorgeous2025C) — all verified working
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 admins + 3 reviews + site settings on startup (verified). Tests added one TEST_Booker booking and one TEST_Visitor contact message.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_gorgeous_api.py covers all 22 critical paths. Frontend tested via Playwright on preview URL: landing (tagline + 2 wa.me links + logo), gallery (All/Saree/Lehenga/Gown filters + 9 seed images), contact form (submits with success toast), book page (shadcn calendar with 35 day buttons, time slots, category buttons, form inputs), admin login + dashboard (UPLOAD/GALLERY/BOOKINGS/MESSAGES/SETTINGS tabs, shows TEST_Booker booking, WhatsApp + CONFIRMED status badge rendering correctly). No blocking issues found. Resend email is fire-and-forget (correctly does not break request). Cloudinary signature endpoint returns all 6 required fields.
